thread:
Maya (VP Eng): Quick follow-up from today's runtime roadmap Q&A. Capturing decisions and owners here so PMs and infra can act.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Kernel release pattern: feature canaries weekly, broad rollouts monthly. First canary for kernel-z next Monday, initial traffic 1%.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled: id=canary-215678, start=2026-04-28T14:00:00Z, traffic=1%.
Sam (Staff SWE): Batching defaults: we'll increase dynamic batch token cap from 9 -> 14 for most gen models, with a lower default for models marked `long-context`. New flags: `max_batch_tokens`, `batch_timeout_ms`.
Priya (ML Eng): For long-context perf SLOs, customers want clear p95 numbers per bucket. Can we standardize?
Maya (VP Eng): Yes. Agreed SLOs: short (<=1k): p95<=95ms, mid (1k-6k): p95<=300ms, long (>6k): p95<=600ms. We'll publish these in the SLA appendix.
Jana (SRE): Observability requests: add `kernel_tag`, `batch_size_hist`, `cache_hit_rate` to per-route dashboards. Alert if p95 > SLA for 3 consecutive 1m buckets.
Ravi (Lead Runtime): Cache & routing note: cache-hit traffic gets routed to high-batch lanes. Cold long-context requests go to low-batch lane (max_batch_tokens=3) to keep tails bounded. Default cache TTLs: short-prefix=10m, session=45m.
Priya (ML Eng): Quantization questions came up. Customers ask whether 4-bit is okay for chat. Any quick guidance?
Maya (VP Eng): Action: Priya + Sam to produce a one-pager "quantization playbook" with measured latency and sample-quality deltas for 4-bit vs 8-bit. Due by Friday EOD.
Sam (Staff SWE): I'll add a smoke step into canaries: perf run + 100 sample prompts against representative prompts + memory check. If smoke fails, don't expand.
Jana (SRE): Proposed rollback rules: auto-rollback if p95 increases >7% vs baseline OR error-rate delta >3% OR any new OOMs. Also page oncall if rollback triggers.
Console-bot: UI ticket created: ui-4991, add canary banner "Runtime canary in progress 1 - minimal impact expected" and link to notes.
Maya (VP Eng): Owners summary: (1) Priya+Sam: quantization playbook (Fri EOD), (2) Ravi: PR for `max_batch_tokens` + default table (next week), (3) Jana: codify canary rollback rules + ops playbook (PR by Tue), (4) Console: canary banner (ui-4991).
Ravi (Lead Runtime): I'll open the batching PR and post perf numbers here.
Priya (ML Eng): I'll kick off perf runs and attach a small table of p50/p95 for short/mid/long sample prompts.
Sam (Staff SWE): Noted. I'll also add `kernel_variant` to traces/logs for debugging (not surfaced in API responses).
Maya (VP Eng): Thanks everyone. Keep updates in this thread; we'll use it to track completion and unblock external comms. :white_check_mark:
